digest.component_or_area: git fetch operations (review bot, opcert service, init command)
propositions: Three network git fetch call sites (gerrit_client.py:367/401, workspace.py:107/124, init.py:398/419) still use 300s wall-clock timeout without throughput-based abort, creating stall exposure identical to the pre-12e4 snapshot fetch
The stall_abort_args() utility from git_fetch module enables throughput-keyed abort (~10s) in place of wall-clock ceiling, allowing byte-starved transfers to fail fast
Each of the three 300s fetch sites must be retrofitted to splice stall_abort_args() into their git fetch invocation and handle stall-triggered retries
Test coverage must distinguish zero-byte remotes (correctly aborted as stalls) from dribbling remotes above throughput floor (must not be aborted), defeating elapsed-time-only implementations
